goal: Add the two missing provider methods dApps expect per Wander's shape -- tokenBalance(id) for per-token balance queries and userTokens(options?) for token discovery -- to packages/messaging/src/page-protocol.ts and the provider dispatch path.
outcome: tokenBalance(id) and userTokens(options?) are real, callable provider methods reachable through the same approval/privilege-tier dispatch background/index.ts already enforces, backed by the existing AO balance path and ao-balance-token-metadata's registry-plus-discovered-token metadata, so a connected dApp can query a specific token's balance or discover the wallet's held tokens without a proprietary extension.

requirements.statement: tokenBalance and userTokens are read-only provider methods -- they do not require the signing-approval window, only the existing connection-approval (Grant) check for the calling origin.

userTokens returns tokens resolved through the existing hardcoded HyperBEAM-verified registry plus any tokens discovered via ao-balance-token-metadata's spawn-tag lookup -- it does not introduce a third, separate token-listing source.
A connected dApp calling tokenBalance(id) for a held AO token receives its real balance; calling userTokens() receives the wallet's actual held-token list.

pnpm vitest run provider bridge approval connected-apps content/index background/index passes; pnpm tsc -p packages/messaging --noEmit and pnpm tsc -p packages/core --noEmit pass; pnpm wxt build succeeds.
